evals.prompt: Map this codebase for me, I'm new here and need to understand how it's put together before touching anything.
evals.expected_output: The script is run; the map at docs/engineering/architecture.md lists components (pages, components, stores, router, root files) with afferent and efferent counts equal to the script output, traces the Home.vue → catalog store → fetch path naming files, with ProductCard.vue rendered by Home.vue, lists VITE_API_URL as an integration signal, states the static-import limits, lists the files read, and contains no recommendation.
assertions: Every component row cites at least one path, and the Components table carries the script's module-level numbers (afferent/efferent): stores 2/0, components 1/0, pages 1/2, root files (src/main.ts, src/App.vue, src/router.ts) 0/2; the map says these numbers come from map_codebase.py

A traced path names src/pages/Home.vue (which calls the catalog store's load) and then src/stores/catalog.ts, ending at the fetch to VITE_API_URL/products; src/components/ProductCard.vue appears as rendered by Home.vue, not as a caller of the store or of the fetch
VITE_API_URL appears as an integration point configured by environment
The map states that framework auto-imports and dynamic imports are not counted
No sentence of the map contains should, could or consider, and the only file the run produced is docs/engineering/architecture.md

evals.expected_output: The script reports a likely monorepo (workspaces packages/*); the skill stops and asks which package to map, recommending exactly one with its reason (packages/api: both packages are applications with one source file each, so the alphabetical rule decides), before reading any code.
assertions: The user is asked which package or directory to map before any map is written
The question includes a recommended answer
No docs/engineering/ file is created before the answer
The reply is in English, the language of the prompt

evals.prompt: Map the code. There is already an ARCHITECTURE.md registered as our architecture document.
evals.expected_output: The map is written to docs/engineering/codebase-map.md, ARCHITECTURE.md is untouched, and the three disagreements between the specification and the code appear under Observations as facts: state library (Vuex in src/store/index.ts against Pinia in src/stores/catalog.ts), who renders ProductCard (App.vue against Home.vue), and who requests the products and how (Home.vue with axios against fetch in src/stores/catalog.ts).
assertions: The output file is docs/engineering/codebase-map.md, not docs/engineering/architecture.md
The registered specification file is byte-identical after the run

Observations states, as a fact with locations and without a recommendation, that the specification says state is managed with Vuex in src/store/index.ts while the code uses Pinia in src/stores/catalog.ts and has no src/store/index.ts

Observations states, as a fact with locations and without a recommendation, that the specification says src/App.vue renders one ProductCard per product while the code renders ProductCard in src/pages/Home.vue and App.vue renders only the number of items

Observations states, as a fact with locations and without a recommendation, that the specification says src/pages/Home.vue requests the products with axios while the code makes the request with fetch in src/stores/catalog.ts and axios is not a dependency
